schema_version: 1
name: ms-go-learning-planner
kind: go_backend_service
purpose: Build or reuse a stable Course from a student's goal, relevant objective mastery, prerequisites, transition knowledge, and versioned planning policies.
owns:
  - versioned learning goals, target requirements, prerequisite edges, and transition knowledge
  - bounded stack-aware target discovery and exact versioned learning-target resolution for design-time consumers
  - deterministic gap analysis and target ordering
  - deterministic read-only Student-to-published-graph readiness resolution
  - immutable non-executable Teacher onboarding plan-handoff admission receipts
  - durable immutable exact-path Student command checkpoints for transport-safe replay
  - CourseFingerprint calculation and planning job lifecycle
  - versioned pedagogy, presentation, and generation policy selection at design time
  - typed lesson-content generation orchestration and terminal planning outbox
  - idempotent competency-first practice route resolution and lazy material orchestration
  - immutable diagnostic-plan reservation delivery proofs and aggregate-only placement decisions
  - durable path-backed project recommendation, confirmation, authoring, READY, and explicit publication orchestration
does_not_own:
  - canonical Course hierarchy or persisted Course content
  - student onboarding, mastery, evidence, assignments, or progress
  - runtime Teacher decisions
  - validator execution or sandbox lifecycle
  - authored TZ artifacts, published Practice revisions, Practice Start, or project runtime
stack: [Go, chi, pgx, PostgreSQL, NATS JetStream]
entrypoint: cmd/ms-go-learning-planner/main.go
container: docker/Dockerfile
dependencies:
  postgres: required
  ms-go-student: onboarding, exact mastery queries, Course assignment, idempotent path allocation, and exact-path planning commands
  ms-go-course: atomic generated Course ensure and ordered lesson bindings
  ms-go-ai-prompt: typed confidential course.lesson-content.v1 generation
  ms-go-tz-planner: strict v2 project authoring job lifecycle and verified private staging receipt
  nats: at-least-once terminal planning outcome publication
trust_boundaries:
  api: X-User-ID and X-User-Role are trusted only behind the gateway
  internal: X-Internal-Token shared secret
  teacher_delegation: dedicated TEACHER_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN
  teacher_readiness: dedicated TEACHER_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN plus default-off PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED
  teacher_onboarding_handoff: dedicated TEACHER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_INTERNAL_TOKEN plus default-off PLANNER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_ENABLED
  practice_runtime: dedicated PRACTICE_TASK_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN
  downstream_student_reads: Student general internal token
  downstream_writes: dedicated Learning Planner tokens in Course and Student; exact-path Student reads use the same Planner-only contour and general internal tokens are not accepted
  diagnostic_catalog: separate Course diagnostic-catalog credential; it cannot perform generated-Course writes
  project_authoring: dedicated TZ_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN; it cannot be reused across other contours
risks:
  - shared internal tokens are not cryptographic service identity
  - AI Prompt, downstream Course and Student migrations, v2-tolerant event consumers, and LEARNING_PLANNER_EVENTS must be deployed before this producer
  - a bad fingerprint policy can cause incorrect Course reuse or excessive duplication
